actions.action: Scrape a midrib dot with a fingernail to check for scale
Wipe the white specks to tell insects from dust
Isolate the plant from other plants
Wipe leaf undersides and stems with 70% alcohol and scrape off bumps, every 5–7 days for 4 weeks
Spray undersides, stems and base with insecticidal soap or neem, every 5–7 days for 4 weeks
Check soil moisture to the bottom of the pot with a chopstick or skewer
Water until it drains, then empty the saucer, when the soil is dry
Optionally trim brown edges with clean scissors

reason: The answer blames environment stress as the main cause and misreads the pests as scale or mealybugs rather than thrips, so the diagnosis is only partial; its alcohol-wipe, soap/neem and isolation routine matches what fixed the plant, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
